title: customer-feedback-chronicle-and-solution-sketches-feb-2025
body:
Purpose:
This is a working chronicle: roll-up of recent customer threads (Dec 2024–Feb 2025), clustered signal, and low-effort solution sketches for the product and SE teams. Goal = handoff to product + eng for 2-week microprobes and to solutions for templated responses. NOT final — contains open questions and raw quote snippets.

Quick synopsis:
- Volume: small set (~12 customers) producing repeated themes across hosted + dedicated.
- Common theme: predictability (latency/cost) + clearer fallbacks when model variants differ.
- New-ish ask: per-route token accounting visible in console for multi-model fallbacks (customers want to attribute spend to feature routes).

Top recurring requests (sorted by mention frequency):
1) Route-level cost attribution and historical breakdown (12 mentions) — customers want to show product managers per-feature spend.
2) Better fallback visibility + simulated rollout preview (10 mentions) — predict what happens if model X is pulled or downgraded.
3) Fine-grained caching controls (8 mentions) — more explicit prefix caching TTLs and eviction metrics per-model.
4) Private deployment onboarding checklist gaps (6 mentions) — networking/KMS checklist unclear for security teams.
5) Streaming edge cases during autoscale events (5 mentions) — truncated/duplicate tokens on mid-request scale-ups.

Representative customer voice snippets (verbatim):
- "We can’t show finance why this feature suddenly spiked our bill; need per-endpoint attribution" — mid-market analytics SaaS
- "If you fallback to a smaller model we need to know the quality delta before enabling it" — fintech client
- "On prem install took 3x the expected time; the checklist missed HSM cert rotation steps" — healthcare customer

Suggested microprobes (0–2 week quick experiments):
A) Console: Add a lightweight per-route cost graph (stored as 30-day rolling window) — UI mock + API flag. Owner: Product-Hosted-API. Risk: low. JIRA seed: CS-3421.
B) Rollout preview simulator: backend dry-run that emits predicted lat/throughput per variant (uses existing perf profiles). Owner: Eng-Serving-Runtime + Product. Risk: medium.
C) Caching knobs: expose TTL + eviction counts in metrics for specific model routes (Prometheus labels). Owner: Observability. Risk: low.

Product bets (Q2 candidate features):
- Route-aware billing exports (CSV + BigQuery sink) with attribution keys mapped to application routes and model variants. Impact: high for customers with multi-feature billing.
- Canary-simulator that computes expected end-to-end latency for candidate model swaps given current traffic mix.

Operational/SE playbook items:
- Create a private-deployments onboarding quicksheet (single page) that includes KMS provider mapping, firewall rules checklist, common failure modes and troubleshooting commands. Owner: Solutions Engineering.
- Template customer email and Slack snippet for explaining fallback behavior and quality impacts; include suggested toggles in console for immediate opt-out.

Edge cases & unknowns (open questions):
- How much additional cost/latency to compute rollout simulator at scale? Needs engineering estimate.
- For route billing, which keys (route name, api_key, model_variant) do customers prefer as canonical attribution? Need 1–2 customer interviews.
- Streaming duplication during autoscale: is this a runtime race or a client-side reattempt? SRE/Serving-runtime to reproduce in staging.

Immediate next steps (this doc → owners):
- Product-Hosted-API: prioritize microprobe A (per-route cost graph) and set an MVE design review by 2025-03-09. (Owner: Maya Chen)
- Eng-Serving-Runtime: triage streaming duplication; create minimal repro by 2025-03-07. (Owner: Samir Gupta)
- Solutions Engineering: draft on‑prem quicksheet and circulate to two pilot customers for validation by 2025-03-10. (Owner: Jordan Lee)

Notes-to-self / collaboration links:
- Slack thread: #cs-feedback-feb-25 (referenced messages 42–58)
- Short customer interview plan attached in linked Confluence (confluence://CS/chronicle-2025) — 3 interviews recommended focused on billing attribution.

Appendix: quick mapping of mentions → priority level
- Billing/Attribution: P0 (12 mentions)
- Rollout visibility/preview: P1 (10 mentions)
- Caching controls: P1 (8 mentions)
- Onboarding checklist (private): P2 (6 mentions)
- Streaming autoscale issues: P2 (5 mentions)

If you want to add raw threads: paste into the doc under "raw-threads" heading; will maintain as separate attachment in next iteration.

-- Elena
(last updated 2025-03-02)
